seasons.note: The NFL announced a 2026 salary cap of $301.2 million per club, $22 million above the 2025 cap of $279.2 million (NFL.com). Default accounting is in_season: the 2026 league year began 2026-03-11 and the regular season began 2026-09-09 (Spotrac CBA calendar). Top-51 is the offseason rule and is available with --rule top51. This file is the league limit only. It is not a team cap sheet and it does not imply any player contract.
